sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [WRONG_APPLICABILITY] generated:ShipShape / nltl:hasStructuralMember: generated:ApplicableStructuralMemberShape is applied to every structural member, so members outside bottom structures and transverse side frames are rejected and are also forced to provide strength, collapse-load, and load-case data. Required change: Condition the substantive member constraints on the member being either bottom-structure or a transverse side-structure frame, while allowing non-applicable structural members to conform without those requirements. | [INVENTED_CONSTRAINT] generated:ShipShape / nltl:frameProfileType: The candidate makes frameProfileType mandatory for every ship, although clause I2.6.1 contains no frame-profile-type requirement and the retrieved term is grounded in an unrelated TRAFICOM requirement. Required change: Remove the mandatory frameProfileType property constraint from this requirement shape. | [WRONG_FORMULA] generated:ApplicableStructuralMemberShape plastic-strength definition SPARQL: The candidate treats plasticStrength and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad as approximately equal using an undeclared tolerance and compares their signed values, while the requirement defines plastic strength by the magnitude of the midspan collapse load. Required change: Require plasticStrength to equal the magnitude of midspanPlasticCollapseLoad without the invented relative or absolute tolerance, unless an authoritative tolerance is supplied. | [UNIT_CONVERSION] generated:ApplicableStructuralMemberShape demand-versus-strength SPARQL and generated:LoadCaseShape: The comparison uses raw qudt:numericValue values for combinedShearAndBendingDemand and plasticStrength, but only plasticStrength is constrained to kN; demand has no unit compatibility or conversion constraint, so numerically comparing quantities expressed in different units can change conformance. Required change: Require the demand to use a unit compatible with the strength and convert both quantities to a common force unit before comparison, or constrain both operands to the same declared unit.

[DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION] deterministic validation: COMPLETE dependency relationship(s) absent from candidate: frameProfileType: COMPLETE dependency relationship(s) absent from candidate: frameProfileType Required change: Correct this deterministic error while preserving all unrelated candidate semantics.

[INVENTED_CONSTRAINT] generated:ShipShape/frameProfileType: The candidate validates every supplied frameProfileType value against nltl:frameProfileTypeValue even though I2.6.1 imposes no frame-profile-type requirement, so unrelated profile data can cause regulatory nonconformance. Required change: Remove the frameProfileType property constraint from generated:ShipShape. | [WRONG_APPLICABILITY] generated:ShipShape/patchLoad: The ForceQuantityValueShape constraint on patchLoad applies unconditionally to every targeted ship, allowing malformed patch-load data to invalidate ships with no bottom-structure member even though the patch-load requirement applies only to bottom structures. Required change: Scope patchLoad quantity validation to ships having a bottom-structure member, together with the existing conditional presence requirement, rather than applying it to every ship.
